set.body: Freeze an independent unopened image-pair cohort and execute the exact automatic public linear candidate without candidate-aware tuning. Count every failure in the denominator and evaluate the frozen accuracy thresholds. Refresh whole-pipeline cost evidence for the identical candidate, charging preparation, capture, all candidate refinements, final audit, and output. Bind source and provider hashes, commands, raw rows, cross-platform gates, and the release decision in a receipt.
set.title: FA-L28: Run fresh sealed automatic linear accuracy and whole-pipeline cost qualification
